name: auditoria-precatorios
description: Comandos do projeto inteiro (Python + front). Rode a partir da raiz do repositório.

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements-dev.txt && .venv/bin/pip install -q -e . && yarn --cwd frontend install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd frontend playwright install chromium && cd web && ../.venv/bin/python manage.py migrate -v0
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n django,vite -c blue,magenta "cd web && ../.venv/bin/python manage.py migrate -v0 && ../.venv/bin/python manage.py runserver 8000" "yarn --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.test: yarn run test:py && yarn --cwd frontend lint && yarn --cwd frontend test && yarn --cwd frontend e2e
